        var odoo = ;

        (function () {
            var JOB_ID   = ;
            var afterId  = 0;
            var lineCount = 0;
            var polling  = true;
            var POLL_MS  = 600;

            var terminal    = document.getElementById('terminal');
            var cursor      = document.getElementById('cursor');
            var badge       = document.getElementById('state-badge');
            var statusText  = document.getElementById('status-text');
            var lineCountEl = document.getElementById('line-count');
            var searchInput    = document.getElementById('search-input');
            var searchCount    = document.getElementById('search-count');
            var searchCountTxt = document.getElementById('search-count-text');
            var searchEscTip   = document.getElementById('search-esc-tip');

            var DONE_STATES = ['done', 'failed', 'cancelled'];
            var userScrolledUp = false;

            /* Track whether the user has scrolled away from the bottom */
            terminal.addEventListener('scroll', function () {
                var atBottom = terminal.scrollHeight - terminal.scrollTop - terminal.clientHeight < 32;
                userScrolledUp = !atBottom;
            });

            function scrollToBottom() {
                if (!userScrolledUp) {
                    terminal.scrollTop = terminal.scrollHeight;
                }
            }

            /* ── RPC helper ── */
            function rpc(method, args) {
                return fetch('/web/dataset/call_kw', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {
                        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                        'X-Csrf-Token': odoo.csrf_token,
                    },
                    credentials: 'same-origin',
                    body: JSON.stringify({
                        jsonrpc: '2.0',
                        method: 'call',
                        id: Date.now(),
                        params: {
                            model: 'cloud.job',
                            method: method,
                            args: args,
                            kwargs: {},
                        },
                    }),
                }).then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
                  .then(function (r) { return r.result; });
            }

            /* ── Render chunks ── */
            var PREFIX = { stdout: 'out', stderr: 'err', system: 'sys' };

            function appendChunks(chunks) {
                var query = searchInput.value.trim();
                chunks.forEach(function (chunk) {
                    var line = document.createElement('span');
                    line.className = 'line ' + chunk.source;

                    var prefix = document.createElement('span');
                    prefix.className = 'prefix';
                    var srcLabel = '[' + (PREFIX[chunk.source] || chunk.source) + ']';
                    prefix.textContent = (chunk.ts ? chunk.ts + '  ' : '') + srcLabel;

                    var text = document.createTextNode(chunk.content + '\n');

                    line.appendChild(prefix);
                    line.appendChild(text);
                    terminal.insertBefore(line, cursor);

                    afterId = Math.max(afterId, chunk.id);
                    lineCount++;
                });
                lineCountEl.textContent = lineCount + ' line' + (lineCount !== 1 ? 's' : '');
                if (query) {
                    applySearch(query);
                } else {
                    scrollToBottom();
                }
            }

            /* ── Search ── */
            function applySearch(query) {
                var lines = terminal.querySelectorAll('.line');
                if (!query) {
                    lines.forEach(function (l) { l.classList.remove('search-hidden'); });
                    searchCountTxt.textContent = '';
                    searchCount.className = 'search-count';
                    searchEscTip.style.display = 'none';
                    scrollToBottom();
                    return;
                }
                var lower = query.toLowerCase();
                var matched = 0;
                lines.forEach(function (l) {
                    var text = l.textContent.toLowerCase();
                    if (text.indexOf(lower) !== -1) {
                        l.classList.remove('search-hidden');
                        matched++;
                    } else {
                        l.classList.add('search-hidden');
                    }
                });
                searchCountTxt.textContent = matched + ' match' + (matched !== 1 ? 'es' : '');
                searchCount.className = 'search-count ' + (matched > 0 ? 'has-results' : 'no-results');
                searchEscTip.style.display = '';
            }

            searchInput.addEventListener('input', function () {
                applySearch(searchInput.value.trim());
            });

            searchInput.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                    searchInput.value = '';
                    applySearch('');
                }
            });

            /* ── Update state badge ── */
            function updateBadge(state) {
                badge.textContent = state || '—';
                badge.className = 'job-state-badge state-' + (state || 'pending');
            }

            /* ── Poll loop ── */
            function poll() {
                rpc('load_chunks', [JOB_ID, afterId])
                    .then(function (result) {
                        if (!result) return;
                        appendChunks(result.chunks || []);
                        updateBadge(result.state);

                        if (DONE_STATES.indexOf(result.state) !== -1) {
                            polling = false;
                            cursor.style.display = 'none';
                            statusText.textContent = 'Job ' + result.state + '.';
                        } else {
                            statusText.textContent = 'Running…';
                        }
                    })
                    .catch(function (err) {
                        statusText.textContent = 'Connection error — retrying…';
                    })
                    .finally(function () {
                        if (polling) {
                            setTimeout(poll, POLL_MS);
                        }
                    });
            }

            poll();
        })();
